create.name: Barbara Deyo
create.bio:
Barbara Deyo is a Reiki master, meditation teacher and spiritual life coach based in the Detroit suburbs of Michigan. She spent close to four decades in the beauty and wellness trade as a make-up artist and esthetician, and still runs Deyo Studio in Birmingham, where energy work now sits alongside the salon. Her own turning point came through personal experiences that led her into Reiki, chakra work, meditation and yoga, and later into oracle cards and readings by the moon. She describes her role as a channel that helps people become their own healers.

In one-to-one sessions, held at the studio or over Zoom, she begins with a conversation and then blends Reiki, crystals, sound, guided meditation and chakra balancing, drawing on angels and guides as she works. Her wider project, The Recalibrated Soul, is a digital sanctuary and weekly podcast about the heart, the soul and changing old inner patterns. She has set out her nine-step method in a guidebook, The Accidental Architect, and in an online course on what she calls frequency shifting. On Insight Timer she offers guided meditations and courses on the archangels, the lunar cycle and working with your own energy.

books.title: The Accidental Architect: The Recalibrated Soul Guidebook
books.author: Barbara Deyo
books.description: Her guidebook to The Recalibrated Soul, setting out the nine-step process she teaches for noticing a reactive state, looking at what lies beneath it and choosing a different response. It is available in paperback, hardback and Kindle.

courses.title: The Art of Frequency Shifting
courses.description: A self-paced online course in three phases that teaches her nine-step method for taking apart fear, drawing out the lesson in a hard moment and choosing a calmer way of being. It ends with a practical audit for everyday situations and a library of worked examples.

courses.title: Energy Healing Sessions at Deyo Studio
courses.description: One-to-one sessions at her studio in Birmingham, Michigan, or by Zoom, starting with a thirty-minute intake conversation. Each session is shaped to the person and may combine Reiki, chakra balancing, sound, crystals and guided meditation; small private group events can also be arranged.
courses.price: $150 USD (1 hour); $225 USD (90 minutes); $300 USD (2 hours); intake $75 USD

courses.title: Understanding Archangels
courses.description: An Insight Timer course that introduces the archangels one by one, with a guided meditation for meeting each of them.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Mastering Your Energy: A Practical Guide To Shifting Your Frequency
courses.description: An Insight Timer course on the basics of energy and vibration, with simple daily practices for noticing your own state and moving it somewhere lighter.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Barbara Deyo on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations on the archangels, the moon's phases and energy, together with several short courses. The single tracks are free to hear.
